record.content: The current campground page describes 63 year-round drive-in sites: 60 paved full-hookup sites and three unpaved water-only sites. It publishes a 12-week maximum and two-business-day minimum booking window; $45 water-only, $65 full-hookup, $8 overflow parking and $8 reservation fees; a reservation-based Coyote Hills parking benefit; gate, quiet, capacity, vehicle, stay, pet, fire, alcohol, smoking, generator, and other campground rules.
